h1: Slive Hotel — a newer central Surin hotel guests praise most for how clean it is
intro: If you want a city hotel in Surin that feels new and spotless without paying much, Slive Hotel is the name that comes up most in recent reviews. Opened in 2017 on Lak Mueang Road, it is an easy walk to the Surin City Pillar Shrine and the shops around it. What guests talk about are the roomy units with in-room kitchenettes, a well-equipped gym, a rooftop sky garden and staff who genuinely look after you. The 37 rooms start at roughly THB 1,000/night, and a real-review score of 9.1 is very high for this price bracket in Surin.

body.html: The thing guests talk about most is how new and clean the place is. Slive Hotel opened in 2017 on Lak Mueang Road in the centre of Surin, a few minutes' walk from the Surin City Pillar Shrine, with convenience stores, cafés and a hospital close by. Visitors here to explore the town or on business say the location is easy to get around — step out for food and coffee right around the hotel.

The hotel has 37 rooms, from Superior Twin and Deluxe Twin to a Family Room and a King Studio. What sets it apart from a typical city hotel is that many rooms come with an in-room kitchenette and a refrigerator, plus a 40-inch flat-screen TV, a free minibar and blackout curtains. Real reviews agree the rooms are large, the beds comfortable and everything spotless — "clean" and "new" are the two words guests reach for most. The decor is modern and well kept, with none of the musty feel of an older hotel.
"Room was new and immaculate, the bed was comfortable, and it even had a little kitchenette. The staff were lovely and so helpful — great value for Surin."

What many guests do not expect at this price is a surprisingly well-equipped gym and a rooftop sky garden to sit out in the evening breeze. The gym may be small, but the machines are new and complete, and plenty of reviews call it better than they expected. There is no swimming pool, so if you are coming specifically to swim this is not the one — but if you want a good, clean room with somewhere to work out and a spot to relax, it fits.

Breakfast earns praise for being fresh — made-to-order omelets and a neatly laid-out buffet with plenty of choice. There is an on-site restaurant and café, a massage room and meeting rooms for anyone here to work. A big convenience for travellers is that the hotel offers free 24-hour pickup from Surin railway station and free airport transfers within 50km, handy if you fly into Buriram and continue to Surin, or arrive by train.

Service is the standout strength here. Staff are repeatedly praised for being friendly and helpful, and many reviews say the team is the main reason they would return. There is free underground parking — rare for a downtown hotel — and strong Wi-Fi throughout the building. Overall the 9.1 from 34 Trip.com reviews and a Tripadvisor ranking of #2 of 12 hotels in Surin reflect guests who are very happy with what they get for the price.

To be straight about it, Slive Hotel is not a luxury resort and has no swimming pool, and the building is fairly compact. Some reviews note inconsistent hot-water pressure in a few showers, a minor leaky sink faucet, and a lift that occasionally stops between floors. A few staff have limited English. But set against the price and how new the rooms feel, these are small gripes. If you are in Surin for the Elephant Round-up, to shop for silk, to visit temples, or simply on business in town and want a fresh, clean room at an easy price, this is one of the best-value choices in the city.

A tip from reading plenty of reviews: if you arrive by train or fly into Buriram, arrange the free pickup with the hotel in advance — it genuinely saves on transport. If you want a room with a kitchenette, specify it when you book, as not every room has one. During the Surin Elephant Round-up (November), rooms fill fast and prices climb, so book several weeks ahead.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Slive Hotel Surin

faq.q: Where is Slive Hotel, and is it easy to reach?
faq.a: The hotel is at 169 Lak Mueang Road in the heart of Surin, near the Surin City Pillar Shrine. It is a few minutes' walk to the City Pillar Shrine, Wat Burapharam and the downtown market, with convenience stores and cafés around it. Surin railway station is about 6 minutes by car, and the hotel offers free 24-hour station pickup.

faq.q: How much are rooms, and what types are available?
faq.a: Rooms start at around THB 1,000/night for a Superior. Options run from Superior Twin and Deluxe Twin to a King Studio with a kitchenette and a Family Room. Prices vary by season and festival, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Slive Hotel have a pool and a gym?
faq.a: The hotel has no swimming pool, but it does have a surprisingly well-equipped gym and a rooftop sky garden to relax in. If you want a pool in central Surin, look at Surin Majestic or Thong Tarin instead.

faq.q: Who is Slive Hotel best for?
faq.a: It is ideal for anyone wanting a new, clean room at an easy price, travellers arriving by train, and guests who want an in-room kitchenette for a longer stay. The central location is walkable to the City Pillar Shrine and markets, with a gym, a rooftop and free station pickup. It leans on being new, clean and good value.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: In normal periods, 1–2 weeks ahead is fine. But for the Surin Elephant Round-up (November) and city festivals, book several weeks ahead, as the hotel has just 37 rooms, fills fast and prices climb. Choose a free-cancellation rate if your plans are not yet fixed.
